model_version_note: API beta launch — initial pricing
notes: Claude 1 API beta opened to early partners March 2023. 9K context window. Pricing reflected limited availability. Deployed in iapi.buzz and deploybase histories.

model_version_note: Claude 2 launched July 2023 at same price as Claude 1.3 per claudearchive
notes: Claude 2 API offered at same price as Claude 1.3 per claudearchive.com pricing history. 100K context window. Claude 2 launched July 11 2023.

model_version_note: Cheaper faster variant
notes: Claude Instant 1.x at $0.80/$2.40 per 1M tokens. Cited by TokenCost AI Price Index July 2023 entry. Exact launch date not confirmed.

model_version_note: 200K context, 27% price cut on input
notes: Claude 2.1 announced Nov 21 2023. Expanded context to 200K tokens. 27% price cut on input tokens ($11.02 -> $8.00). Tool use (function calling) introduced in beta. Source: iapi.buzz and claudearchive.com.

model_version_note: Frontier model launch — Claude 3 family
notes: Claude 3 Opus launched March 2024 at $15/$75 per 1M tokens. Frontier model. 200K context window. Part of Claude 3 family (Opus/Sonnet/Haiku). Source: TokenCost AI Price Index.

model_version_note: Balanced model — Claude 3 family
notes: Claude 3 Sonnet launched March 2024 at $3/$15 per 1M tokens. Balanced model. 200K context window. Most popular Anthropic model at this price point for extended period. Source: TokenCost AI Price Index.

model_version_note: Budget tier — Claude 3 family. Later replaced by Claude 3.5 Haiku then Haiku 4.5
notes: Claude 3 Haiku launched March 2024 at $0.25/$1.25 per 1M tokens. Budget tier. 200K context window. Price increased with subsequent Haiku generations. This is the original price — not the current Haiku price. Source: TokenCost AI Price Index.

model_version_note: Upgraded Sonnet — same price as Claude 3 Sonnet, improved coding and tool use
notes: Claude 3.5 Sonnet launched June 21 2024 at $3/$15 per 1M tokens. Same price as Claude 3 Sonnet but improved coding and tool use. 200K context window. Per claudearchive.com pricing history.

model_version_note: Only time Anthropic raised API prices — higher than Claude 3 Haiku
notes: Claude 3.5 Haiku introduced October 2024 at $0.80/$4.00 per 1M tokens. This is the ONLY time Anthropic raised API prices — higher than Claude 3 Haiku's $0.25/$1.25. 200K context window. Source: iapi.buzz Anthropic pricing history. Note: this model was later replaced by Haiku 4.5.

model_version_note: October 2024 updated version — same price, improved capabilities
notes: Updated Claude 3.5 Sonnet released October 2024 alongside Claude 3.5 Haiku. Same $3/$15 price as original Claude 3.5 Sonnet. Improved coding and tool use. 200K context window. Source: iapi.buzz.

model_version_note: Frontier model — replaced Claude 3 Opus pricing tier
notes: Claude Opus 4 launched May 2025 at $15/$75 per 1M tokens. Frontier model. 200K context window at launch. Later expanded to 1M. This pricing was the peak for Opus tier before the Opus 4.5 cut. Source: TokenCost AI Price Index.

model_version_note: Replaced Claude 3.5 Sonnet — same price maintained
notes: Claude Sonnet 4 at $3/$15 per 1M tokens. Maintained same price as Claude 3.5 Sonnet. 200K context window at launch, later 1M. Source: TokenCost AI Price Index. Per claudearchive: Sonnet 4.5 (Sep 29 2025) kept Sonnet 4 pricing at $15/MTok output.

model_version_note: 67% price cut from Opus 4 ($15/$75 -> $5/$25). Pricing held across Opus 4.5/4.6/4.7/4.8/5
notes: Claude Opus 4.5 launched November 24 2025 at $5/$25 per 1M tokens. 67% cut from Opus 4's $15/$75. 200K context window at launch. Pricing held constant across Opus 4.5, 4.6, 4.7, 4.8, and Opus 5. Source: claudearchive.com and CloudZero Claude pricing.

model_version_note: Maintained Sonnet 4 pricing — $3/$15 across Sonnet 4, 4.5, 4.6
notes: Claude Sonnet 4.5 announced September 29 2025. Kept Sonnet 4 pricing at $3/$15 per 1M tokens. 200K context window. Later expanded to 1M context flat rate with Sonnet 4.6. Source: claudearchive.com.

model_version_note: GA March 13 2026 — flat rate 1M context, no surcharge above 200K
notes: Claude Opus 4.6 GA March 13 2026 at $5/$25 per 1M tokens. 1M context window at standard pricing — flat rate, no surcharge above 200K tokens. Leads SWE-bench Verified benchmarks. Model-by-model pricing held from Opus 4.5. Source: APIScout LLM API pricing comparison March 2026.

model_version_note: GA March 2026 — flat rate 1M context, best value Anthropic model
notes: Claude Sonnet 4.6 at $3/$15 per 1M tokens. 1M context window at standard pricing — flat rate, no surcharge above 200K tokens. Best value Anthropic model. Same price maintained across Sonnet 4, 4.5, 4.6. Source: APIScout LLM API pricing comparison March 2026.

model_version_note: Current Haiku — replaced Claude 3.5 Haiku ($0.80/$4.00) with further price increase
notes: Claude Haiku 4.5 at $1/$5 per 1M tokens. 200K context window. Recently updated from Claude 3.5 Haiku ($0.80/$4.00). Offers better quality at budget-tier pricing per CloudZero. Source: CloudZero Claude pricing August 2026.

model_version_note: Introductory pricing; Sept 1 increase to $3/$15 was cancelled — $2/$10 became permanent Aug 11 2026
notes: Claude Sonnet 5 launched June 30 2026 with introductory pricing of $2/$10 per 1M tokens through August 31 2026. Was scheduled to increase to $3/$15 on September 1 2026. NOTE: Anthropic cancelled the Sept 1 increase on August 11 2026 — $2/$10 became the permanent rate. 1M context window. Source: claudearchive.com and CloudZero Claude pricing.

model_version_note: Permanent rate after cancellation of Sept 1 increase
notes: Anthropic made Claude Sonnet 5's $2/$10 rate PERMANENT on August 11 2026. Cancelled the planned September 1 increase to $3/$15. Teams that reforecast on the higher number are now over-budgeting Sonnet by 50% per CloudZero. 1M context window. Source: CloudZero Claude pricing August 2026.

model_version_note: Current flagship — same $5/$25 rate as Opus 4.5 through 4.8 across five releases
notes: Claude Opus 5 at $5/$25 per 1M tokens. Same rate across five straight releases (Opus 4.5 through Opus 5). 1M context window flat rate. Most capable generally available Anthropic model alongside Fable 5. Source: CloudZero Claude pricing August 2026. Note: models from Opus 4.7 onward use a tokenizer producing ~30% more tokens for same text per CloudZero.

model_version_note: Premium tier — most capable generally available Anthropic model, shares rates with limited-availability Mythos 5
notes: Claude Fable 5 at $10/$50 per 1M tokens. Premium tier. 1M context window. Shares rates with limited-availability Mythos 5. Most capable generally available Anthropic model. Source: CloudZero Claude pricing August 2026.

model_version_note: Batch API rate — 50% off standard
price_tier_note: Batch API: 50% off standard rates for async work completed within 24 hours
notes: Claude Opus 5 batch rate: $2.50/$12.50 per 1M tokens. 50% off standard $5/$25. Nightly pipelines, bulk classification, content generation. Source: CloudZero Claude pricing.

model_version_note: Batch API rate — 50% off standard
notes: Claude Haiku 4.5 batch rate: $0.50/$2.50 per 1M tokens. 50% off standard $1/$5. Source: CloudZero Claude pricing.

model_version_note: Cached token rate — 90% discount on cached reads
price_tier_note: Cached reads: $0.30/MTok vs $3.00 standard input (90% discount). Only applies to cached prompt prefixes.
notes: Claude Sonnet 4.6 cached reads at $0.30 per 1M tokens — 90% discount from standard $3.00 input. Applies to cached prompt prefixes. Source: CloudZero Claude pricing.

model_version_note: Fast mode — 6x standard rates for latency-sensitive workloads
price_tier_note: Fast mode: 6x standard rates ($5/$25 -> $30/$150). For latency-sensitive workloads only.
notes: Claude Opus 4.8 fast mode at $30/$150 per 1M tokens — 6x standard rates. For latency-sensitive workloads. Source: CloudZero Claude pricing. Note: Mem0 cites 2x standard rates for fast mode — discrepancy between sources; using CloudZero's 6x figure as more specific.

model_version_note: US-only inference premium
price_tier_note: US-only inference: 1.1x standard input + output rates ($5/$25 -> $5.50/$27.50)
notes: US-only inference premium: 1.1x standard rates. Source: Mem0 Anthropic Claude pricing.

model_version_note: Web search tool pricing — separate from model token pricing
price_tier_note: Web search: $10 per 1,000 searches. Not token-based.
notes: Anthropic web search tool: $10 per 1,000 searches. Separate from model token pricing. Source: Mem0 Anthropic Claude pricing May 2026.
